verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Issuing supports a synchronous webhook for real-time authorization decisions, showing webhook-based event delivery exists, but the pack contains no evidence of broader webhook event subscription (e.g., issuing_card.*, issuing_dispute.* events, webhook endpoint management API) that a general 'subscribe to events' story implies. Missing for 10: documentation of the full Issuing webhook event catalog, webhook endpoint setup/management API, and any AI-native tooling (e.g. MCP) for consuming these events.
